decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are used.
Condition : 3 - The windows formed in the east and west elevation at high level  shall be obscure glazed,  and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 4 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 5 - It is considered that this application for the retention of the existing single-storey rear extension to dwellinghouse  and the demolition and resiting  of the rear building to form a shed is acceptable   This is because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of No. 113 Mogden Lane and would not be detrimental to the visual amenity of the locality or to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Adopted UDP policies  ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Retention of a single storey rear extension and demolition of existing garage and the erection of a single storey shed to rear garden
